**Files to fix:**
- `src/app/(features)/gaming/loading.tsx` (create new)
- `src/app/(features)/apple/loading.tsx` (create new)
- `src/app/(features)/search/loading.tsx` (create new)

**How to fix:**
Copy the pattern from `src/app/(features)/work/loading.tsx`. Here's the exact content to create for **gaming** and **apple** (they share the same category page layout):

```typescript
// src/app/(features)/gaming/loading.tsx

export default function Loading() {

        <div className="container mx-auto px-4 py-8">

            <div className="flex gap-8">
                {/* Sidebar Skeleton */}
                <div className="hidden w-[280px] shrink-0 lg:block">
                    <div className="h-[600px] w-full rounded bg-gray-100 animate-pulse" />
                </div>

                {/* Main Content Skeleton */}

                    <div className="mb-6 h-10 w-full rounded bg-gray-100 animate-pulse" />
                    <CategoryGrid laptops={[]} isLoading={true} isEmpty={false} />

    )
}
```

For **search**, the layout may differ (no sidebar). Create a search-appropriate skeleton:

### 2. [WARN] Accessibility: Missing aria attributes in Features A components
**What's wrong:** Feature browsing, filter, and search components lack aria attributes. Only `search-typeahead.tsx` has any aria usage currently.
**Files to fix:**
- `src/components/features/browsing/category-grid.tsx` (add aria to grid container)
- `src/components/features/filters/*` (add aria-label to all filter controls)
- `src/components/features/search/search-typeahead.tsx` (review — already has some, extend)
- `src/app/(features)/gaming/page.tsx` (add metadata export)
- `src/app/(features)/apple/page.tsx` (add metadata export)
- `src/app/(features)/search/page.tsx` (add metadata export)
- `src/app/(features)/work/page.tsx` (add metadata export)

**How to fix:**
For filter components — every `<select>`, `<input>`, `<button>` needs an `aria-label`:
```tsx
// Filter dropdowns:
<select aria-label="Filter by brand" ...>
<select aria-label="Filter by screen size" ...>
<select aria-label="Sort results" ...>

// Reset button:
<button aria-label="Clear all filters" ...>
```

For category grid:
```tsx
<section aria-label="Laptop results" role="region">
  <ul role="list" aria-label="Laptops matching your filters">
    {laptops.map(laptop => <li key={laptop.id}>...</li>)}
  </ul>
</section>
```

For each page.tsx, add a metadata export:
```typescript
// src/app/(features)/gaming/page.tsx
import type { Metadata } from 'next'
export const metadata: Metadata = {
  title: 'Gaming Laptops',
  description: 'Compare gaming laptop prices across 16+ retailers. Find the best deals on RTX and high-performance laptops.',
  openGraph: {
    title: 'Gaming Laptops | TopComp',
    description: 'Compare gaming laptop prices across 16+ retailers.',
  },
}
```

Repeat the metadata pattern for `/apple`, `/work`, and `/search` pages with appropriate titles/descriptions.
